description: Read, register, update, and record execution outcomes for named workflow patterns and site quirks in ~/.weavetab-system/memory/sites/. Use action='get' at session start to inspect a site profile and decide between fast-path replay (reliability ≥ 0.8) or exploratory navigation. Use action='learn' after completing a multi-step flow to persist it. Use action='record_execution' to update reliability scores after replay attempts.

action.description: 'get': inspect site profile and known workflow patterns. 'learn': create/update a named pattern. 'record_execution': update reliability after replay. 'record_quirk': store a site quirk.

entry.description: URL path or pattern where this workflow starts.

name.description: Pattern name in snake_case (required for 'learn' and 'record_execution').

origin.description: Full origin associated with the pattern, e.g. 'https://github.com'. Required for write actions. If omitted with action='get', reads the active tab origin.

pattern.description: With action='get': returns reliability score for this specific named pattern only.

success_indicator.description: CSS selector or URL fragment confirming workflow success.

name: browser_pattern_learn
